title: windrose_plus_data/rcon/cmd_<id>.json
description: A console command handed to the mod: written by the dashboard server (cmd_ps_*), by host panels (cmd_api_*), then listed by name in rcon/pending_commands.txt (CRLF lines, a UTF-8 byte order mark is tolerated). Only names matching cmd_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+.json are read. A command older than 30 seconds is answered as expired.
